ImageDescription.value: 3.21M of Puerto Rico citizens are speakers of a non-English language, which is N/A the national average of 21.5%. In 2015, the most common non-English language spoken in Puerto Rico was Spanish. 92.2% of the overall population of Puerto Rico are native Spanish speakers. 0.04% speak French and 0.03% speak Chinese, the next two most common languages. When compared to other states, Puerto Rico has a relatively high number of residents that are native Spanish speakers. In 2015, there were 3.2M native Spanish speakers living in Puerto Rico, approximately 6.77 times more than would be expected based on the language's frequency in the US more broadly.
